verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਥਰੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਲੁਕਿਆ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਜਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: paaras pathar aakheeaai lukiaa rahai na aap janaae|

en.bdb: Philosopher's stone remains hidden and does not publicise itself.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਇ ਸਿਞਾਣਦਾ ਖੋਜੀ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਏ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: viralaa koi sin(j)aanadhaa khojee khoj le so paae|

en.bdb: Any rare one identifies it and only a prospector gets it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਅਪਰਸੁ ਹੋਇ ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਰਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: paaras paras aparas hoi asaT dhaat ik dhaat karaae|

en.bdb: Touching that stone, the lowly metals transform into one metal, gold.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਹ ਵੰਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਮੁਲਿ ਅਮੁਲਿ ਵਿਕਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: baareh va(n)nee hoi kai ka(n)chan mul amul vikaae|

en.bdb: Becoming pure gold those metals are sold as invaluable ones.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਘੜ ਘੜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal saadhasa(n)g sabadh surat liv aghaR ghaRaae|

en.bdb: The pleasure fruit of gurmukhs is the holy congregation where merging consciousness into Word, the clumsy mind is chiselled into beautiful shape.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਲਿਵ ਲੀਣੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੈਂਸਾਰੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਭਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: charan saran liv leen hoi sai(n)saaree nira(n)kaaree bhaae|

en.bdb: Even a worldly person here, concentrating upon the feet of Guru, becomes dear to God, the formless One.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਰੀ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਏ ॥੯॥
verses.translit_en: ghar baaree hoi nij ghar jaae ||9||

en.bdb: Becoming householder, man resides in his innate nature (atman).
